message.en: Over 30 mm/h of rain recorded near UM. Avoid low-lying paths near Tasik Varsiti and the Jalan Universiti underpass. Wait indoors if you can.
message.ms: Hujan melebihi 30 mm/j direkodkan berhampiran UM. Elakkan laluan rendah berhampiran Tasik Varsiti dan terowong Jalan Universiti. Tunggu di dalam bangunan jika boleh.

message.en: Sg. Klang at Bukit Putra has reached Alert level (25.12 m; Alert from 24.70 m). No flooding on campus yet. Check the app before travelling towards KL Sentral or Mid Valley.
message.ms: Sg. Klang di Bukit Putra mencapai paras Waspada (25.12 m; Waspada bermula 24.70 m). Tiada banjir di kampus setakat ini. Semak aplikasi sebelum ke arah KL Sentral atau Mid Valley.

message.en: API reached 118 (Unhealthy). Limit outdoor sports and wear a mask outdoors if you have asthma.
message.ms: IPU mencecah 118 (Tidak Sihat). Hadkan sukan luar dan pakai pelitup muka di luar jika anda menghidap asma.
